title: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus (Copenhagen 1872) (Senfl)
desc: Ludwig Senfl, Vivo ego, dicit Dominus (Copenhagen 1872). 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor I, Tenor II, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Copenhagen 1872. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
